data.name: Rushd
data.gender_notes: Rushd is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'R-SH-D', meaning 'to guide', 'to lead aright'. The name Rushd carries the meaning “Wisdom, Intellect” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rushd usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, intellect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rushd is considered a gift from Allah, symbolizing divine guidance and wisdom.
data.etymology: Rushd belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom, Intellect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rushd total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رشد
in_arabic.meaning: هدایت یافتہ، رشد یافتہ، کسی کام کی درستی و استواری
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشد (ر-ش-د) کی اصطلاح اسلامی علم کی اصطلاحات میں بہت اہمیت رکھتی ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن و حدیث کے معیار پر مبنی ہے۔ یہ لفظ 'رشد' کے معنی میں ہے، یعنی کسی کام کی درستی و استواری، حق و صواب کا انتخاب کرنا، یا بصیرت و ہدایت یافتہ ہونا۔

in_urdu.name: رشد
in_urdu.meaning: هدایت پر چلنے والا، صحيح راستے پر
in_urdu.long_meaning: رشد کا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ہدایت یافتہ یا کسی کام کی درستی و استواری۔ اسلامی روایات میں، 'رشد' کی اصطلاح اہل حق و صواب کے لئے استعمال ہوتی ہے، جو بصیرت و ہدایت کے ساتھ ہیں اور صحیح راستے پر چلتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रुश्द
in_hindi.meaning: निर्देशित, सही रास्ते पर चलने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुश्द नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन प्राप्त या सही रास्ते पर चलने वाला। इस्लामी परंपराओं में, 'रुश्द' की शब्दावली उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग की जाती है जो सत्य और न्याय के मार्ग पर चलते हैं और जिनके पास आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान और हिदायत होती है।

in_pashto.name: رشد
in_pashto.meaning: پهدایت شوی، په سمه لاره روان
in_pashto.long_meaning: د رشد نوم etymology د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د هدایت یا سمې لارې روان دی. د اسلامي رواياتو په وينا، 'رشد' د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې د حق او صواب په لاره روان دي او د بصیرت او هدایت سره سم دي.

in_english.name: Rushd
in_english.meaning: Guided, Righteous, One who follows the correct path
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rushd originates from Arabic roots (ر-ش-د), signifying guidance, righteousness, or following the correct path. In Islamic tradition, it denotes individuals endowed with insight and guidance, adhering to truth and justice as per Quranic principles and prophetic teachings. Historically, it reflects a spiritual attribute valued in Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rushd holds great significance in Islamic and Arabic culture. It is often used as a term to describe a person of great knowledge, wisdom, or guidance. In the Islamic teachings, Rushd is often given as a title or epithet for prophets, scholars, and spiritual guides, reflecting their role in guiding people towards the truth and righteous path. In various Islamic texts and traditions, the concept of Rushd is emphasized as a valuable attribute for every individual to strive for, as it implies not just having knowledge and understanding, but also the ability to apply it wisely, make good choices, and contribute positively to society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rushd embodies the essence of one's quest for knowledge, guidance, and wisdom from the divine source. It reflects the belief that true knowledge and understanding are essential for leading a righteous and fulfilled life. Rushd is often considered as a reminder of Allah's guidance and the importance of seeking His guidance in all aspects of life. It underscores the idea that the ultimate goal of life is to Act Righteously (amal salih) and to achieve the blessings of Allah both in this world and the next. The name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of seeking Allah's help, relying on His guidance, and living according to His will.

historical_references.reference: Rushd was a Persian philosopher and theologian, born in 1126 in Damascus, Syria. He is considered one of the greatest thinkers of the Islamic Golden Age, and is known for his works on logic, ethics, and theology.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rushd remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
